zh.text: 貨幣數量論

en.text: According to the equation of exchange, when the money supply is fixed,

zh.text: 根據交易方程式，當貨幣供應固定時，

en.text: the growth rate of nominal income is constant.

zh.text: 名義收入的增長率是常數。

en.text: the growth rate of real output is the same as the inflation rate.

zh.text: 實質產出的增長率等於通脹率。

en.text: the growth rate of nominal income is the same as the growth rate of the velocity of circulation of money.

zh.text: 名義收入的增長率等於貨幣流通速度的增長率。
通脹率是零。

en.text: According to the equation of exchange, if money supply grows at the same rate as nominal income, we can conclude that

zh.text: 根據交易方程式，若貨幣供應與名義收入以相同速度增長，我們可得出結論：
物價水平正在上升。
實質產出維持不變。

en.text: the velocity of circulation of money is constant.

zh.text: 貨幣流通速度維持不變。
以上皆是。
香港高級程度會考 2002 卷二 第 19 題

en.text: If the velocity of circulation of money is constant and the money supply increases by a fixed amount each year, which of the following diagrams shows the value of nominal income over time?

zh.text: 若貨幣流通速度維持不變，而貨幣供應每年增加固定金額，下列哪幅圖顯示名義收入價值隨時間的變化？
香港高級程度會考 2002 卷二 第 23 題

en.text: Suppose the velocity of circulation of money is held constant. According to the equation of exchange, if the growth rate of money supply is smaller than that of the real gross national product (GNP), we can conclude that

zh.text: 假設貨幣流通速度維持不變。根據交易方程式，若貨幣供應的增長率低於實質本地居民生產總值的增長率，我們可得出結論：
出現通貨緊縮。
通脹率正在下降。
失業率正在上升。

en.text: the growth rate of real GNP is higher than the inflation rate.

zh.text: 實質本地居民生產總值的增長率高於通脹率。
香港高級程度會考 2005 卷二 第 18 題

en.text: When the velocity of circulation of money is constant, an increase in the money supply will lead to

zh.text: 當貨幣流通速度維持不變，貨幣供應增加會導致
通貨膨脹。
通貨緊縮。
實質產出增加。
名義產出增加。

en.text: The classical quantity theory of money

zh.text: 傳統貨幣數量論

en.text: predicts that changes in money supply may have no effect on the general price level.

zh.text: 預測貨幣供應改變可能對一般物價水平沒有影響。

en.text: predicts that changes in nominal national income are positively related to changes in money supply.

zh.text: 預測名義國民收入的改變與貨幣供應的改變呈正向關係。

en.text: assumes that the velocity of circulation of money is constant.

zh.text: 假設貨幣流通速度維持不變。
香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 32 題

en.text: In the long run, a change in money supply will

zh.text: 長期而言，貨幣供應改變不會影響
物價水平。
實質產出。
名義貨幣需求。
以上皆是。

en.text: The above diagram shows that during the period

zh.text: 上圖顯示，在該段時期

en.text: there is deflation in the economy.

zh.text: 該經濟有通貨收縮。

en.text: the growth rate of money stock is negative.

zh.text: 貨幣供應量增長率為負數。

en.text: the general price level is rising.

zh.text: 一般物價水平正在上升。

en.text: the standard of living is rising.

zh.text: 生活水準正在上升。
香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 34 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the classical quantity theory of money is

zh.text: 下列哪項有關古典貨幣量理論的陳述是不正確的？

en.text: Both the velocity of circulation of money and the real output are assumed to be constant.

zh.text: 貨幣流通速度和實質產出均假設為不變。

en.text: Any change in money supply will lead to the same proportional change in nominal output.

zh.text: 貨幣供應的任何改變會導致名義產出產生同等比例的改變。

en.text: Deflation will occur when there is a continuous fall in money supply.

zh.text: 當貨幣供應不斷下降時，通縮便會出現。

en.text: Any change in price level will lead to the same proportional change in money supply.

zh.text: 物價水平的任何改變會導致貨幣供應產生同等比例的改變。
香港中學文憑考試 練習卷 卷一 第 33 題

en.text: The real output of an economy grows at a lower rate than the money supply. According to the quantity theory of money, we can conclude that

zh.text: 某經濟的實質產出有所增長，其增長率較貨幣供應的增長率爲低。根據貨幣量理論，我們可得出結論如下：
物價水平正上升。
失業率正下降。

en.text: the velocity of circulation of money is decreasing.

zh.text: 貨幣流通速率正下降。
名義產出正上升。
香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 32 題

en.text: Suppose the velocity of circulation of money remains constant. If a central bank reduces money supply by 10%,

zh.text: 假設貨幣流通速率維持不變。若中央銀行減少貨幣供應 10%，

en.text: the price level will decrease by 10%.

zh.text: 物價水平會下跌 10%。
實質產出會下跌 10%。

en.text: nominal output may decrease by less than 10%.

zh.text: 名義產出可能下跌少於 10%。

en.text: real output may decrease by less than 10%.

zh.text: 實質產出可能下跌少於 10%。
香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 37 題

en.text: The quantity theory of money implies that

zh.text: 貨幣數量理論意味著

en.text: an increase in money supply will lead to a rise in price level when real output is falling.

zh.text: 當實質產出正在下降，增加貨幣供應會令物價水平上升。

en.text: the economy is always at the full employment output level.

zh.text: 該經濟經常處於全民就業產出水平。

en.text: an increase in money supply will lead to a decrease in the velocity of circulation of money when real output is kept constant.

zh.text: 當實質產出維持不變，增加貨幣供應會令貨幣流通速率下降。

en.text: an increase in money supply will lead to a same-proportional increase in real output.

zh.text: 增加貨幣供應會令實質產出有相同比例的提升。
香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 33 題

en.text: According to the classical quantity theory of money, which of the following diagrams is correct when money supply is growing at a constant percentage each year?

zh.text: 根據古典貨幣量理論，當每年的貨幣供應以一固定的百分率增長時，下列哪幅圖是正確的？
香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 34 題

en.text: According to the quantity theory of money, if a central bank increases money supply,

zh.text: 根據貨幣量理論，若中央銀行增加貨幣供應，
價格水平會上升。
實質產出會維持不變。
名義產出會上升。
失業率會下降。

en.text: According to the quantity theory of money, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 根據貨幣量理論，下列哪項陳述是正確的？
通脹率是零。

en.text: The growth rate of real output is increasing.

zh.text: 實質產出的增長率正在增加。

en.text: The growth rate of money supply is constant.

zh.text: 貨幣供應的增長率是固定的。

en.text: The growth rate of nominal income is constant.

zh.text: 名義收入的增長率是固定的。
香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 37 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about quantity theory of money are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關貨幣數量理論的陳述是正確的？

en.text: If money supply is growing too fast relative to the supply of goods in the economy, inflation will occur.

zh.text: 若某經濟的貨幣供應相對於物品供應增長得太快，通脹便會出現。

en.text: If money supply increases, nominal output will increase by the same percentage.

zh.text: 若貨幣供應增加，名義產出便會以相同的百分率增加。

en.text: If inflation rate is constant, real output will grow at the same percentage as money supply.

zh.text: 若通脹率是固定的，實質產出和貨幣供應會以相同的百分率增長。
香港中學文憑考試 2019 卷一 第 35 題
細閱下圖。

en.text: According to the quantity theory of money, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 根據貨幣數量理論，下列哪項陳述是正確的？
實質產出正在上升。
名義產出正在下降。
貨幣供應正在下降。

en.text: The velocity of circulation of money is decreasing.

zh.text: 貨幣流動速度正在下降。
香港中學文憑考試 2021 卷一 第 38 題

en.text: According to the classical quantity theory of money, if the money supply of an economy increases by 8%,

zh.text: 根據古典貨幣數量論，若某經濟的貨幣供應上升 8%，________。

en.text: the government's income tax revenue will increase by 8%

zh.text: 政府的入息稅稅收會上升 8%

en.text: the nominal output will increase by 8%

zh.text: 名義產出會上升 8%

en.text: the real output will increase by 8%

zh.text: 實質產出會上升 8%

en.text: the price level may increase by less than 8%

zh.text: 物價水平可能上升少於 8%
香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 37 題

en.text: Which of the following about the quantity theory of money is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項關於貨幣數量論是正確的？

en.text: An increase in money supply will not affect the nominal output in the long run.

zh.text: 貨幣供應上升不會影響在長期的名義產出。

en.text: If the money supply growth rate is constant, the price level will also be constant in the long run.

zh.text: 假如貨幣供應增長率固定不變，在長期的物價水平亦會固定不變。

en.text: If the price level is constant, a decrease in real output will lead to a decrease in money supply.

zh.text: 假如物價水平固定不變，實質產出下降會導致貨幣供應下降。

en.text: If the real output growth rate is zero, the price level growth rate will be equal to the money supply growth rate.

zh.text: 假如實質產出增長率為零，物價水平增長率會等於貨幣供應增長率。
